speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will be asking your parent about your symptoms and medical history to help me understand your condition. To start, how old are you in days, and have you noticed any fever, poor feeding, or changes in your breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sepsis (early onset) / Meningitis due to lack of prenatal care and immunization. The history of no prenatal care and missing immunizations is highly concerning for Group B Streptococcus or E. coli sepsis in a newborn. Given the risk factors, I recommend immediate blood cultures, CBC with differential, CRP, and a lumbar puncture to rule out meningitis.
